verdict.rationale: Metronome is a billing platform, so control of billing anchors and cycles is an applicable axis. However, the evidence pack only mentions billing periods in passing: invoices finalize at the end of a period, and price changes apply at the start of the next one. Nothing documents calendar vs anniversary anchoring, aligning a customer's subscriptions, or setting custom invoice dates.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can control billing anchors and cycles — calendar vs anniversary billing, alignment across a customer's subscriptions, custom invoice dates
